title: Troubleshoot Email Delivery Issues
job_text:
1. Go to Gmail's SMTP logs to review recent delivery attempts.
2. Look for common issues like bounce messages, sender reputation scores, or authentication protocol errors.
3. Decide the cause of failed deliveries based on the issues found.
4. Return a list of potential causes and recommendations for improvement.
what_happened: A customer support specialist checked the email authentication services and SMTP logs to identify the cause of failed email deliveries.

evidence.note: Public Grok Bot setup attributed to @euboid.

I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result.
